text:
sre-maria: Pager: hosted-api eu-west p99 latency and request backlog growing rapidly. noticed GPU pools at 100% and autoscaler failing to provision. tagging oncall.
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api.eu-west p99>5s, queue depth > 12k, gpu-pool-util=100%, autoscaler_errors=QuotaExceeded (see /alerts/1719009999)
infra-raj: I'm in. looking at provisioner logs now. `provisioner.create` is returning 403 quota errors to cloud provider, looks like our project quota hit for v100s in eu-west-1.
eng-lin: Confirmed sudden traffic burst from one tenant (identified by api-key hash). Could be an A/B test or runaway loop. Spike started ~1719009800.
sre-maria: Cooked runbook: 1) enable fallback-model-routing to cpu-backed small models, 2) throttle incoming tenant to preserve global SLOs, 3) open support ticket for cloud quota increase, 4) manual scale of dedicated pools if capacity available in nearby region.
infra-raj: Trying manual grow: `redwoodctl pool increase --pool hosted-eu-w-1-gpu --count 6` -> returns `QuotaExceeded: requested 6, available 0`.
eng-lin: Routing patch ready. Pushing canary to route 30% of requests to cpu-fallback. patch: ```json
{"routes":[{"match":{"model":"gpt-large"},"action":{"fallback":"gpt-small-cpu","percent":30}}]}
```
cs-amy: Heads-up: customer success already getting DMs from two paying customers in EU complaining about timeouts. marking them as P1 and initiating CRM messages.
sre-maria: Applying routing canary now. will monitor p95/p99 and queue. setting Slack status to incident.
incident-bot: RUNBOOK STEP: enable auth-based throttles for culprit tenant. Command: `redwoodctl throttle set --tenant <id> --rps 10 --burst 50`
infra-raj: Throttle applied to tenant hash ab12f... now we see ingress drop ~70% from that key. queue growth rate slowed.
eng-lin: Canary routing deployed. cpu-fallback serving ~28% of traffic, p99 overall dropped from 6.9s -> 3.2s, queue from 12k -> 6.5k.
sre-maria: Nice. Next: open cloud quota emergency request. Raj, do you want me to escalate to provider ops? I can provide usage graphs.
infra-raj: Please escalate. I've opened a ticket (INC-4511) and requested temporary quota raise + preemptible pool allocation. ETA unknown.
cs-amy: Notifying impacted customers in status page. message: "We're mitigating a capacity issue in EU; routing to fallback models and applying tenant throttles. Some requests may be slower or time out. We will update in 15 minutes." :warning:
eng-lin: Observability note: KV cache hit rate dropped during fallback which accounts for some extra latency on cache-miss paths. adding note to postmortem.
sre-maria: Ops summary so far: throttled offending tenant, enabled 30% cpu fallback, manual pool scale blocked by quota, cloud ticket opened. Monitoring p99 and queue. handoff to night oncall at 1719010800.
infra-raj: Leaving logs for handoff: `provisioner.log` shows repeated 403s from compute quota. Also attached `routing-change` diff and throttle command output.
incident-bot: INCIDENT HANDOFF: severity=high, impact=timeout and high p99 for hosted-api eu-west, mitigations in place, next oncall=<eng-lee>, handoff_ts=1719010800
eng-lee: ack. I'll pick up monitoring and escalate with provider contacts if no quota response in 30m. please post any new errors under this thread.
sre-maria: Thanks team. set follow-up reminder for postmortem and verification of fallback correctness once quota + scale restored. :white_check_mark:
